Converted distances to metres before comparing them.
Ordered three mixed-unit distances correctly: 1800 m, 1 km 900 m, 2 km.
Found differences by converting to metres and subtracting; 2100 m − 1600 m = 500 m.
Initially compared 2 km and 500 m without matching units; corrected this later by converting 2 km to 2000 m.
Teach-back was not passed; subtraction with mixed units needs more practice.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised converting distances to the same unit, ordering mixed-unit distances, and finding differences. They used the correct method of changing kilometres to metres and later corrected the mix-up of comparing the numbers without matching units. At home, give two or three distances such as 3 km 200 m and 1 km 750 m, and ask Arjun to convert both to metres before comparing or subtracting.
